### TYPED
Returns the values of `field` whose source mapped them as `type`, and null for every other row. Performs no conversion: a value is included because the index that supplied it mapped the field as that type, not because the value looks like one.

```esql
FROM sample_data, sample_data_str METADATA _index
| EVAL mapped_as_ip = TYPED(client_ip, "ip")
| KEEP _index, @timestamp, mapped_as_ip
| SORT _index ASC, @timestamp DESC
```
